about: Covered walk-throughs: registry building parts that bridge a lane at first-floor level. The game leaves the ground open under them. 'photo' ones are confirmed; 'likely' ones are read from the registry (a thin two-storey strip joining two blocks) and the aerial (an alley leading to each end) and need Dave to confirm.
